currentUserGoal: Run over the front-end UI, checking for mistakes, glitches, legibility, and clarity across desktop and mobile.
changesMade: Audited the title screen, main HUD, Skill Map, Quest Log, Seed Lab, store, automation, journal, and options on desktop at 1280x720.
Audited the same core UI surfaces on mobile portrait at 390x844 using fieldShape=rect1200 to inspect a full unlocked stress state without the debug perf overlay covering the UI.
Added a narrow-phone check at 320x700 for the main HUD and Quest Log.
Fixed a compact Quest Log layout bug where seven filter buttons were laid out in more rows than the panel reserved, causing the final filter to collide with the first quest row.
Made compact Quest Log filter rows derive from the actual responsive column count so 390px uses two rows and very narrow phones can use three rows cleanly.
Shortened the mobile Quest Log summary text so the resource count no longer wraps into the status line on 320px-wide screens.
